title: Inspection Picture Guide
intro: A quick visual guide for Flint's Health and Safety inspections. When in doubt, take a photo and note it, and James will decide.

sections.heading: Flag it
items: Covered or tampered smoke detectors and sprinklers
Tapestries or posters on the ceiling, within 24" of it, or covering more than half a wall
Extension cords (only grounded power strips with a circuit breaker are OK)
Hot plates, air fryers, rice cookers, crockpots, grills
Alcohol and high-risk drinking gear (beer funnels, beer pong tables)
Weapons, including BB and airsoft guns

sections.heading: Note it, don't take it
items: Microwaves without an internal smoke detector and auto shutoff: check the box and tell the resident

sections.heading: OK for this round
items: Free-standing TVs (wall-mounted TVs are not allowed)
